title: Book Three · Chapter 156: The First Term
story:
A week later, the coastal centre's reply arrives.

Ronan takes the letter to the table. Mum moves her sewing basket so the papers can lie flat.

The year has two terms. Each term has four months of classes and practice.

Ronan puts a pencil mark beside that line. This is the coastal programme. He keeps Anna's two-year information out of this count.

The present class fee is one hundred and eighty yuan for a term. A shared room costs sixty for the same term.

He adds them on his own sheet.

“Two hundred and forty,” he says.

Mum reads the next line.

“Food isn't there.”

“No.”

He leaves a clear space below the room cost. Travel and other first needs go in another space.

The centre has sent a sample lesson page too. There is a customer message beside a little order list.

Ronan reads the message once. He can see the main question. The numbers take longer.

Mum takes her own work back to the window. Ronan copies three of the main subject names from the letter: written work, number work, and customer practice.

He likes the last one best. He circles all three on the original sheet.

When Dad comes home, Ronan shows him the costs and the empty spaces.

“We need to find out about food,” he says. “And the journey.”

Dad reads the room line twice.

“Four months for this amount?”

“Yes. A shared room for that term.”

“Ask what they provide in the room.”

Ronan writes the question down. A bed does not tell him about blankets or things for the desk.

Dad sits beside him and studies the sample page.

“Do they give you a place now?”

“No. These are details. I still need to ask for the application information.”

Dad nods. He gives the letter back, and Ronan folds it along the old line.

He finishes a short follow-up request that evening. It asks about food costs, room supplies, and the application information. The next morning, he posts it from his separate spending money.

That afternoon, he shows Anna the first sheet at the library. She points to the empty food space.

“My mum asked about that too.”

“There are a lot of spaces.”

“Better than the wrong numbers.”

Ronan smiles and leaves the space open. Anna takes out her own drawing, and he moves the price sheet aside so the two can share the table.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

provide＝提供；supplies＝生活或学习所需物品；sample＝示例；application＝申请。

## 理解问题

1. 沿海项目每学期多久、课程和住宿现价合计多少？有没有把Anna两年课程混算？
2. 哪些费用和条件仍未知？这封回信是否已经给了Ronan录取名额？

## 读句子

**He leaves a clear space below the room cost.**

拆开看：He / leaves a clear space / below the room cost.

他／留出一块空白／在住宿费用那一栏下面。
